name: Sofia de Vries
bio: Sofia runs the practical side of working at Vellumridge. She makes travel, purchasing, and equipment requests easy to follow without losing the details needed for approval.

Purchasing requests, software subscriptions, equipment orders, and cost centers.
Recording lost-device incidents and arranging replacement laptops. Contact the on-call engineer first to secure a missing device.
